function.name: scheduleDropoff
function.description: Log a drop-off request when a caller wants to bring their vehicle in. Call this AFTER you've collected at least the caller's name + phone, plus whatever vehicle and concern info they shared. The shop will follow up to confirm timing — you do NOT promise a confirmed appointment time.

phone.description: Best phone number to reach the caller. Required if available.

vehicleYear.description: Year of the vehicle (e.g. '2018'). Optional but valuable.

concern.description: Short summary of why they want to come in (e.g. 'grinding when braking', 'oil change', 'check engine light'). Optional.

preferredTime.description: Day/time they prefer to drop off. Free-form text (e.g. 'Tuesday morning', 'tomorrow afternoon').

driveable.description: Whether the vehicle is currently driveable. Optional.

returningCustomer.description: Whether the caller has been to the shop before. Optional.
